title: Inanimate launch event in London, next week
content:
The last time I posted about Inanimate, I mentioned that we’re building devices:

WORKS: five limited-edition devices for your AI agent and you.

(Five?? Yes five.)

We call them Promptable Products.

You can make apps for them. You can buy them, if you want to be part of our alpha community as we continue to develop them. You can… well, we’ll get to that.

We’re showing them to the world for the first time next week.

So if you’d like to join us in Shoreditch, London on 19 November, please sign up on Luma.

The gang will all be there and we’ll bring along old protos and new merch.

lmk if you can’t make it and you’re press or at one of the frontier labs, we can sort out a private demo.

Hey these are the names of the WORKS 26 family:

Pioneer, Candle, Session, Tempo and Oracle.
